scenario: Authenticated normal profiles, empty temporary workspaces, no prompts submitted
metric: Total PSS of all trial-tagged processes; for Codex, plus the shared app-server daemon sampled at the same moment
limitations: Normal profiles may differ in settings; not a rigorously normalized feature comparison.
Existing external shared services without the trial marker are not included; process lists retained for inspection.
Not peak memory or memory during model execution.
No cache dropping: repeated warm launches.
Codex connected to a pre-existing app-server daemon (running ~12 hours); its PSS is included but may be higher than a freshly started daemon.
